parties: Godawari Power and Ispat Limited; N P Agrawal
headline: Godawari Power and Ispat Limited: SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 10(6)
sum: N P Agrawal filed a SEBI takeover disclosure with NSE under Regulation 10(6) of the SAST Regulations 2011, reporting an acquisition made in reliance upon a statutory exemption. The filing indicates an acquisition event at Godawari Power and Ispat Limited, a Nagpur-based power and steel integrated manufacturer.
implication: Regulation 10(6) exemptions (typically for acquisitions below thresholds, or by persons acting in concert meeting carve-outs) allow substantial stake accumulation without triggering open-offer obligations; this filing documents compliance with disclosure-reporting duty post-acquisition, a key procedural gate in takeover regulation.
detail: N P Agrawal submitted a Regulation 10(6) disclosure report to NSE, indicating an acquisition in GPIL made under an exemption provided under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The filing is procedural-demonstrating that the acquirer met an exemption criterion (e.g., acquisitions below the 25% threshold, or by certain classes of investors) and is now complying with post-acquisition disclosure obligations. Godawari Power and Ispat is an integrated power and steel manufacturer headquartered in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with operations in thermal power and specialty steel production.
